name: lightdash-org-admin
description: Lightdash Organization Administration plugin for managing users, groups, and organization settings.

interface.shortDescription: Manage Lightdash organization users, groups, projects, and spaces.
interface.longDescription: The Lightdash Organization Administration plugin provides skills for managing users and groups, reading project and space configurations, and administering organization-level settings. Supports both read and write operations with safety mode enforcement for destructive changes.
